# BM//MD movement journal — motion sources

The website remains a plain JavaScript application with its existing React islands.
No new framework or paid library was installed.

- React Bits ScrollReveal, by David Haz: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/src/content/TextAnimations/ScrollReveal/ScrollReveal.jsx
  Upstream Git blob e52b2d188cababdd9ef698e44d4206fa3d124e08. The clamped stagger, piece opacity interpolation and cubic rise were adapted into `studio-redesign.js`, with no blur, a readable base opacity, Chinese character segmentation and both site and OS reduced-motion handling. Upstream source is included beside this file. The original React Bits licence and Commons Clause notices remain in `../reference-effects/`.
- Uiverse arrow button, by alexmaracinaru: https://uiverse.io/alexmaracinaru/perfect-panda-77
  Upstream Git blob 6faa439b580c3e72670c2004d76983ab4a2995ab, repository `uiverse-io/galaxy`, file `Buttons/alexmaracinaru_perfect-panda-77.html`. The arrow translation and press scale are retained, with this site's palette, type and compact corner radius. Upstream source and the MIT notice are included.
- Aceternity UI Container Scroll Animation: https://ui.aceternity.com/components/container-scroll-animation
  Reference for scroll perspective only; the DOM implementation is original and requires no Aceternity package.
- MotionSites: https://motionsites.ai/
  Reference for specimen-led hero composition and scene pacing. No paid prompt, template, asset or code was copied.

Existing equipment photographs and their original provenance notices are retained. No new stock footage, customer figures, testimonials or personal training records were added.
